verdict.rationale: ByteAsk ships a `--sandbox` flag. The default read-only mode can still build and run code under AddressSanitizer, and `--sandbox workspace-write` is required before the agent may build, test, or write files. An `--ask-for-approval` policy adds a second gate on actions. Missing for 10: any evidence of network-access restrictions inside the sandbox, detailed docs on sandbox modes and isolation mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
